read.en: Applied Materials fell 3.3% on Nov 4 to $369.40, trading between $362.93 and $383.65. It is below the falling 5-day ($387.52), 10-day ($388.99), 30-day ($450.44) and 100-day ($504.32) averages and the rising 200-day ($445.31). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram roughly flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($424.41), and RSI is 33.5.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月4日下跌 3.3%，收于 $369.40，盘中区间 $362.93–383.65。股价位于下行的 5 日（$387.52）、10 日（$388.99）、30 日（$450.44）和 100 日均线（$504.32）以及上行的 200 日均线（$445.31）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图大致持平；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$424.41），RSI 为 33.5。

read.en: The close broke both the $377.1–378.7 and $372.8–373.3 supports, which now act as resistance. Resistance is $372.8–378.7 (Oct 23, Nov 2–3 and Apr 29 lows), then $383.7–390 (Nov 4 high, 5 and 10-day, Nov 3 high) and $405.2–409.9. Support is $362.9 (Nov 4 low), then $355.3–359 (Mar 10 and Apr 1 highs). A close above $378.7 would target $384–390; below $362.9, $355–359.
